$comment: Build, test, lint and render commands for repositories you trust. Every rule here can execute code from the checked-out repository (MSBuild targets, conftest.py, package.json scripts, the program a helm template --post-renderer names), so an untrusted clone can run arbitrary code unprompted. Merge by hand into ~/.claude/settings.json only on machines where every clone Claude Code opens is one you would run these commands in yourself; the installer does not apply this file. helm template is here, not in permissions.json, because its --post-renderer runs a program from the clone and --output-dir/--dependency-update write files, and ask rules, which match the command text as written, do not stop a quoted spelling of those flags.
